implementation.native_response: Required observedAt, native status and weekly window counts from the same record/time/authorization observation; rebuild older debug APKs. No native method/permission added.
implementation.draft: Extract existing per-section validation/merge; field Use stages local draft, Preview never installs. No invented API revision/account or implicit backend write.
implementation.activation: Existing native revision comparison/readback confirms explicit Apply/Update/Resume/Stop. Pending intent masks active claims until confirmed; ambiguous writes never replay automatically.
implementation.presentation: Pure mapper uses confirmed native observation time. Scheduled, active, stopped, permission, failed, absent, unavailable and unknown remain distinct; no sample metrics.
implementation.lifecycle: Owner scope and visibility keys fence stale state/callbacks. Native boundary and bounded quiet polling refresh presentation, not enforcement. Queued reads recover foreground return during pending work.
implementation.navigation: Staged drafts survive Home/Settings; dirty inline changes and closing unapplied drafts need explicit Keep/Discard. App selector owns Back. Bottom navigation respects safe insets.
